messages:
incident-bot: P1 — EU canary p95 latency spike detected for hosted inference. Rollout health check failed: p95_latency_ms > 2000ms for 3m. Suspected deploy tag: release/2026-03-17-eu-quantv2
alex: I'm taking this. Paging SRE and ops. Triggering PD and will coordinate manual intervention.
oncall-bot: @alex acknowledged incident PD-4528 (oncall: alex)
maria: ML infra: canary was switched to quant-v2 in EU only. Seeing KV cache growth and GC churn across eu-ml-1..eu-ml-3. Memory trending up.
tom: ops: automated rollback didn't fire because rollout gate expects metric name `latency_p95` but exporter emits `p95_latency_ms`. Policy mismatch — manual killflip required.
alex: Action: 1) flip canary flag for EU to stable, 2) siphon traffic & drain canary pods, 3) push image rollback if needed. Executing flag flip now.
alex: ```
# flip staged model flag for EU
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/internal/flags/flip" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"env":"eu","flag":"staged_model_variant","value":"stable"}'
```
alex: flipped staged_model_variant -> stable :white_check_mark:
ton: ops: starting traffic siphon. Will cordon/drain nodes and run `kubectl rollout undo` on deployment/canary-eu if pods don't terminate gracefully.
maria: prepping image revert: will retag service to release/2026-03-10-stable and push in ~90s. Noting the KV cache warm-up for quant-v2 has an edge-case leak on <16GB hosts.
kim: PM: any confirmed customer impact? Jess, can you confirm CS status?
jess (support): CS: two customers reported high latency spikes and one 504 in the last 12m (eu-west). Created support ticket TKT-776 and sent provisional notice.
alex: Observability: synthetic probes show p95 recovering overall, but two canary pods still in high-heap/restart loops. Tom — isolate logs + heap dumps and upload.
ton: collecting logs now. Commands: `for p in $(kubectl get pods -l app=canary-eu -o name); do kubectl logs $p > $p.log; done && tar czf pd-4528-logs.tar.gz *.log`. Uploading to incident storage.
maria: preliminary root cause: KV cache resize + quant-v2 memory pattern triggers leak on small-memory instance. Workaround is to revert to stable quant implementation. We'll add an integration test for cache bounds and a canary memory sanity check.
kim: Customer comms: will post update saying rollback in progress, ETA 20-30m for improved performance. Jess, please send.
jess (support): Draft sent: "We
re rolling back the recent EU canary model due to elevated latency. We've paused the rollout and are reverting to a stable model; you may see improved performance shortly. We'll provide another update within 30 minutes. 










"
alex: Manual rollback completed, traffic siphoned. p95 back to baseline for 5m on synthetic probes :thumbsup:.
oncall-bot: Incident PD-4528 status: mitigated. Please file a postmortem if any customer-facing impact or SLA exposure occurred.
kim: I'll own the customer-facing postmortem and coordinate the RCA. Follow-ups: add metric-name validation to rollout gate, add canary memory sanity test, and patch quant-v2 leak.
jess (support): Customer update posted. :email:
alex: Thanks everyone. Leaving monitoring on for 1h and collecting artifacts for postmortem. Closing Slack loop unless we see a regression.
